About us

Gugu Basel is an independent family guide bringing together weekend activities in and around Basel, practical family guides, and family-friendly offers across Switzerland — thoughtfully curated to make family planning easier and everyday discoveries more enjoyable.

Created and independently managed by Basel-based mom Kübra Bulut Sengupta, Gugu is built around a simple idea: helping families discover experiences, places and opportunities genuinely worth sharing.

We also welcome selective collaborations with local businesses and brands whose activities, products or services bring real value to families in our community. Our recommendations remain guided by relevance and usefulness, not by commercial arrangements, and paid partnerships are clearly identified.

Terms

Information is provided for general guidance. Event details, prices, discounts, stock and booking conditions can change. Please confirm current information directly with organisers or retailers before visiting, booking or buying; featured deals are not guaranteed to be the lowest price.

Gugu Basel curates information but does not organise events, sell tickets or retail products. Third-party websites, services and transactions are subject to their own terms and remain outside our control.

Any sponsored content, paid partnerships or affiliate links will be clearly labelled. Editorial inclusion is not a guarantee or endorsement.

Original Gugu Basel content and branding are protected where applicable. Third-party materials and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

Privacy

Gugu Basel is designed to collect as little visitor data as reasonably possible. The feedback form does not require a name, email address or account. Messages are transmitted through FormSubmit (formsubmit.co) to the Gugu Basel mailbox. The service may process technical data such as IP addresses for operation and abuse prevention. Please avoid including identifying or sensitive information in the message.

Website Analytics

With your permission, we use Microsoft Clarity to understand visits and improve Gugu Basel. Clarity collects usage and device information, including clicks, scrolling and session recordings that reconstruct how the website is used. Clarity is not loaded until you choose “Accept analytics”. If you reject analytics, Clarity remains off. Advertising storage permission stays denied.

You can change or withdraw your choice at any time using Privacy settings below. Withdrawal stops future Clarity collection on this page by reloading it and removes accessible first-party Clarity cookies; it does not erase data already collected. We remember your choice on this browser for up to 180 days. Clearing website data may reset it.

Microsoft processes the analytics data. Processing may take place outside Switzerland, including in the United States. Details about Microsoft’s processing, retention and international transfer safeguards are available in Microsoft’s Privacy Statement and Clarity’s privacy information.

Technical data may still be processed by website hosting, DNS and infrastructure providers as necessary to deliver, operate and secure the website. Their processing is governed by their own terms and privacy practices.

You may also contact Gugu Basel through Instagram DM or email. Information you send through Instagram is processed under Instagram's own terms and privacy practices.

The website contains external links to Instagram, event organisers, venues, retailers and other third-party websites. When you open an external link, the destination service's own privacy policy and data-processing practices apply.

Gugu Basel does not sell personal data to advertisers or other third parties.
